headline: What makes a system a system · 08:42

items.title: 08:42 · Calling racism a system requires demonstrating that
items.detail: Calling racism a system requires demonstrating that it possesses the formal anatomy of a system in engineering and systems theory.

items.title: 08:50 · In rigorous analytical usage the word system
items.detail: In rigorous analytical usage, the word system designates a bounded, feedback-regulated machine with measurable state variables and governing equations.

items.title: 08:57 · A formal system satisfies a five-part engineering
items.detail: A formal system satisfies a five-part engineering checklist: identifiable components, a policed boundary, defined inputs and outputs, an objective function or purpose, and stabilizing feedback loops.

items.title: 09:08 · We can audit the American racial hierarchy
items.detail: We can audit the American racial hierarchy against each of those five requirements using the equations and diagrams in Chapters 0, 2, and 4.
